notes.title: A message about Nivalis' Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to take a moment to give you an update on the development of Nivalis.

During the last months we have made major progress, and everyone can feel the final game shaping up. The world of Nivalis is a complex and very unique take on the slice-of-life genre. It was ambitious from the start. Combining restaurant management, decorating, apartments, farming, fishing and boat exploration with a compelling story is a challenging task.

We’re seeing the game coming together and are very excited about it. But we won’t be able to release Nivalis in Spring. At the moment we are implementing the final iterations on the UI and inventory management, we’re balancing the economy and fixing all the blockers. We’re also tying all the story threads together, implementing them into the game before we can start with the VO recording for every character (yes!) in the game.

Please bear with us, game development is a constant process of implementation, testing and iteration. We want to make things right; we love this world and all the characters in it. We will update you soon on the release date. And then you can expect to see a lot more of the game on our social media channels. We can’t wait to show you.

The ION LANDS Team

notes.title: Nivalis - Official Summer 2024 Trailer and Release Date Update
notes.notes:
As part of today's 2024 Games Baked in Germany event, we shared some exciting and important updates on Nivalis. Not only did we have an-all new trailer to showcase, but we have a release window!

Nivalis will be launching in Spring 2025! 

Our city has taken on a life of its own, growing and evolving in ways we are eager to share with you. To give you a glimpse of what's to come, please check out our newest trailer featuring lots of never-before-seen locations, train travel and story hints through Ava, one of the main characters you will meet in the game! 
 
Ensuring that Nivalis provides the best possible experience is our priority. Your patience and support are invaluable as we navigate through this creative journey. Thank you for your understanding and continued encouragement!
